command.name: Undermine
verbatim: Each Round: 10% chance to reduce Physical Damage Dealt of 3 Enemies in any lane by -10% for 1 round(s). The duration is doubled (2 rounds) against targets afflicted with Burn.
Rounds 1, 3: Deal Fire Damage to 3 Enemies in any lane (Damage Rate: +20%).
Rounds 5, 7, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +80%).

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Battle Dread
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce the Strength and Initiative (enhanced by Intelligence) of 3 Enemies in any lane by -4% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Mindful Synergy
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Intelligence and Instinct (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Allies in any lane by +4% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Deepen The Breach
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase your Fire Damage Dealt for 5 rounds. Start of Round 6: Increase the Fire Damage Dealt of 1 other Ally within adjacency for 5 rounds. After Combat: Increase your Tile Damage Dealt to the tile's durability.

habits.name: Dragon's Ire
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Tactical and Fire Damage Dealt by +4% until the end of combat.

habits.name: The Long Siege
habits.verbatim: Start of Rounds 6-10: Reduce the Physical Damage Received of 3 Allies in any lane by -5% until the end of the round. When Defending, double this effect (-10%).
